newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says to launch new model V70 XC.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says to launch new model V70 XC.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Tuesday it was to launch a new model within its V70 series, the V70 XC.
"Compared with the regular V70, the XC has approximately 25 mm of increased ground clearance and 50 mm increased ride height," Volvo said in a statement.
It said the variant had a new front, including a grill and a spoiler, new roof rails with crossbars, new wheels and other updated design features.
"We are putting out more variants now than we have in the past. We have a new emphasis on producing variants," Volvo spokesman Ulf Thorne told Reuters.
Volvo said the V70 XC AWD (all wheel drive) would go into production this autumn.
